job: Put things side by side with even space.
purpose: A horizontal flex box. data-gap sets the space, data-wrap lets children wrap, data-justify spreads them (between, center, end) and data-align lines them up across the row (start, end, baseline, stretch). Put fd-grow on the child that takes the leftover space. Use data-align="end" for a field with a button beside it.
useWhen: Children sit on one line: a title and its actions, a field and a button.
A toolbar or a footer lines up controls with a gap.

avoidWhen.when: Children form equal columns that reflow.
A field and a button are one value.

variants.useWhen: Children align to the top of the row.
Children align to the bottom, so a button lines up with an input and not its label.
Text of different sizes shares a baseline.
First child at one end, last at the other.
Children at the end, as actions.
Children wrap to a new line when the row is narrow.

relation.because: A row lays items side by side and wraps them; a stack puts them one under another with a gap.
